title: Short Interest, Returns, and Fundamentals
one_line: Short interest predicts returns because short sellers anticipate bad news, negative earnings surprises and downward analyst revisions months ahead; controlling for that future fundamental news, the short interest-return link disappears.

findings.statement: Short sellers anticipate negative fundamental news months before it is public.
Short interest-return relation vanishes once future news is controlled for.

reported_results.headline: Short interest predicts returns because short sellers anticipate bad news, negative earnings surprises and downward analyst revisions months ahead; controlling for that future fundamental news, the short interest-return link disappears.

data_fit: Single-stock study — not testable on our ES/NQ data.
